This allows you to redirect from X (Twitter) to nitter.kareem.one, which is powered by Nitter.

**Nitter** is a free and open-source alternative Twitter front-end focused on privacy and performance.

nitter.kareem.one is just one of many Nitter instances. You can find other instances here:

- https://status.d420.de
- https://github.com/zedeus/nitter/wiki/Instances#tor
